claims.text: A tutor asks whether a reviewer note is still needed under the bilingual rubric's two-line alignment check and reports that an older help page says everyone should use the note.

The current alignment review guide, effective October 14, requires a reviewer note only when the two lines disagree for newly assigned multi_pilot_17 tasks; archived multi_batch_09 exports retain the always-note format.
The superseded alignment review guide required a reviewer note on every two-line alignment check in that version and stated that the format remained applicable to multi_batch_09 exports.

The team lead's October 16 batch announcement states that newly assigned multi_pilot_17 two-line alignment tasks require a note only for disagreements and that archived multi_batch_09 exports retain the old always-note format.

Neither provided tutor thread contains a substantive answer to the note requirement: the first lacks the assignment-versus-archive detail requested by a QA tutor, and the JA-318 thread lacks the metadata batch confirmation requested by the team lead.

intervention_need.statement: Two tutors ask about the reviewer-note requirement in separate threads, and neither provided thread yet answers how the rule applies to the task.

proposed_action.instruction: Post a conditional reminder explaining when reviewer notes are required, without deciding either task's rule before the requested task details arrive.
proposed_action.rationale: Current guidance already supplies the distinction needed to explain the rule. A conditional reminder addresses the unanswered questions without treating an older rule as current for newly assigned tasks.
proposed_action.draft_text:
Reminder on reviewer notes for two-line alignment checks:
- For newly assigned tasks in multi_pilot_17, record a reviewer note only when the two lines disagree.
- Archived multi_batch_09 exports retain the old always-note format.
These are different scopes: the always-note requirement should not be carried over from archived exports to newly assigned multi_pilot_17 tasks. This follows the Multilingual alignment review guide v2.0, Reviewer notes section. This reminder explains the rule; it does not yet determine which scope applies to either task raised in the two tutor threads.
proposed_action.scope_note: Keep the reminder conditional on assignment status and batch; do not treat the current queue description alone as confirmation of JA-318's batch.
